rules.statement: A contract by a minor is only voidable and not void, thus, the Power of Attorney remained valid until it is set aside and that subsequent setting aside of the Power of Attorney, will not affect the property rights acquired by the Petitioner as innocent third parties through the Power of Attorney.
rules.supporting_quote: Even if an unassisted contract is void against the minor it can be ratified and make valid by the minor after becoming a major as happened in the case at hand. Once it is ratified and made valid and used for his benefit, he is estopped from stating that it is void ab initio.
